newsitem.title: USA: Blount to buy 2 outdoor supply companies.
newsitem.headline: Blount to buy 2 outdoor supply companies.

text.p: Blount International Inc said Monday it has signed a letter of intent to acquire the stock of Frederick Manufacturing Corp of Kansas City, Missouri, and Orbex Co of Circle Pines, Minnesota.
The company said it expects the acquisitions to increase its sales by $20 to $25 million in the first year and be accretive to earnings in the first year of ownership.
Both companies supply outdoor products, including lawn mower and sporting goods accessories under the Silver Streak, Aladdin and other product names.
Blount said they into to close the deals by January 2 if all contractual and regulatory contingencies are met.
